udmc_sync.message.agent_ready: Close Minecraft. UDMC will update after the game exits. Wait a few seconds, then start the game again.
udmc_sync.message.ready: Pack files have changed. Close and restart Minecraft before joining the server.
udmc_sync.message.verified: Your files are up to date. You can join the server.
udmc_sync.message.conflict_backup: Only the named file will be disabled. A backup will remain in udmc-sync/backups. Restart Minecraft afterwards.
udmc_sync.message.admin_conflict: The pack administrator needs to resolve this conflict. No local file will be removed.
udmc_sync.message.disabled:
%1$s
Backup: %2$s
Restart Minecraft to check the remaining mods.
udmc_sync.message.confirm_disable:
%1$s
A backup will be created. Other files will not be removed.
udmc_sync.login.missing: The UDMC client did not answer the server. It is either not installed, or an older one that cannot answer this server yet - in that case restarting the game once is enough.
udmc_sync.login.incompatible: The UDMC client uses a protocol this server does not speak.
udmc_sync.login.outdated: The UDMC client is outdated: the server hands out %1$s, you have %2$s.
udmc_sync.login.notice:
UDMC: %1$s

How to fix:
1. Open in a browser: %2$s
2. Download the file into your mods folder
3. Start the game and join again
udmc_sync.title.confirm_disable: Remove this file from the game?
udmc_sync.error.connect: Could not connect to UDMC. Check your connection and ask the administrator whether the server is running.
udmc_sync.error.timeout: The UDMC server did not respond in time. Try again later.
udmc_sync.error.tls: The secure connection could not be verified. Check your computer's clock and contact the administrator. Do not disable certificate checks.
udmc_sync.error.unknown: The operation could not be completed. Details are in logs/latest.log (%1$s).
udmc_sync.error.other_pack: Another pack already manages this game directory. Use a separate game profile.
udmc_sync.error.replay: The server returned an older release. It was rejected to prevent a possible replay attack.
udmc_sync.error.manifest_file: Invalid or duplicate file in the pack: %1$s
udmc_sync.error.url: The UDMC server address is invalid. Contact the administrator.
udmc_sync.error.https: This client requires HTTPS. Ask the administrator for a secure server address.
udmc_sync.error.manifest_http: Could not retrieve the pack: HTTP %1$s.
udmc_sync.error.manifest_size: The pack manifest exceeds the permitted size.
udmc_sync.error.manifest_project: The pack manifest is invalid or belongs to another project.
udmc_sync.error.platform: The Minecraft version or mod loader does not match this pack.
udmc_sync.error.download_size: The download size does not match the pack: %1$s
udmc_sync.error.hash: The downloaded file failed its SHA-256 check: %1$s
udmc_sync.error.signature_missing: The pack signature or trusted public key is missing. No pack files were changed.
udmc_sync.error.signature: The pack signature could not be verified. No pack files were changed.
udmc_sync.error.agent_signature: The agent update signature or project/platform identity could not be verified.
udmc_sync.error.agent_http: Could not retrieve the agent update: HTTP %1$s.
udmc_sync.error.agent_size: The agent update size is invalid or the download is incomplete.
udmc_sync.error.agent_install: Automatic updates require the generated UDMC JAR to be installed in this profile's mods folder.
udmc_sync.conflict.changed: This file differs from the required pack file. It cannot be overwritten without your permission.
udmc_sync.conflict.inspect: Could not inspect this %1$s mod. Ask the administrator to check the JAR; details are in logs/latest.log.
udmc_sync.conflict.version: The pack requires %1$s. Your personal JAR has a different version or SHA-256 hash.
udmc_sync.conflict.duplicate: Duplicate of %1$s. Keep no more than one copy in the mods folder.
udmc_sync.error.server_only: A server-only mod was sent to this client: %1$s. Contact the administrator.
udmc_sync.error.mod_limit: Too many local mods to inspect safely. Contact the administrator.
udmc_sync.error.admin_conflict: The pack administrator needs to resolve this conflict.
udmc_sync.error.file_changed: The file changed after the check. Run the check again before removing it.
udmc_sync.error.backup: The backup could not be verified. The original file was not removed.
udmc_sync.error.locked: Minecraft is holding this file open. Close the game and remove %1$s manually. Backup: %2$s
udmc_sync.diagnostic.nested_versions: Different embedded versions of %1$s need manual review: %2$s
udmc_sync.diagnostic.optional: %1$s (%2$s): installed optional dependency %3$s does not satisfy %4$s.
udmc_sync.diagnostic.overwrite: A personal server mod would be overwritten: %1$s
udmc_sync.diagnostic.side: %1$s is assigned to %2$s, but its metadata requires %3$s.
udmc_sync.login.foreign: The UDMC client is installed but set up for another project. This server needs the project "%1$s".
udmc_sync.message.unconfigured: This UDMC file is not set up for any server: it was built from source instead of handed out by Control. Download the client from your server's install page.
udmc_sync.login.restart:
UDMC: %1$s

Close the game and start it again: the client updates itself, nothing to download.
udmc_sync.title.unclaimed: UDMC is not set up yet
udmc_sync.message.unclaimed: UDMC is installed but does not belong to a modpack yet. Join the server whose pack you want: it will offer you its project, and you decide whether to accept it.
udmc_sync.message.setup:
The server offers the modpack “%1$s” and will manage the mods in this game folder.

Its signing key:
%2$s

Accept only if this is your server or one you trust. The owner can show you the same key in UDMC Control.
udmc_sync.message.other_project: This game folder is set up for “%1$s”, and this server hands out “%2$s”. Two modpacks cannot share one mods folder. Use a separate game profile for the other server.
udmc_sync.message.key_changed:
“%1$s” now signs with a different key than the one this client trusts:
%2$s

Either the owner rebuilt the project, or this is not the server you think it is. Ask the owner to confirm the key before doing anything else. Nothing has been changed.
udmc_sync.login.unclaimed: The UDMC client is installed but not set up for any modpack yet. Leave this screen and UDMC will ask at once whether to set this game up for “%1$s”. Accept, let it finish, and join again.
